author: The_Illuminati_
body:
Hello, it's me again. Sorry to bother you so soon, but I was banned yet again for something I did not do. I was playing control the hill, and a bunch of people on my team were abusing a glitch with demo in which you can have unlimited grenades. I was not a part of it, and did not abuse said glitch. I was really hoping that I could be unbanned, as this is my favorite server, and i'm even thinking of donating :D.
Thanks so much,

The_Illuminati_
